candidates.content: Store agent observations and summaries in a persistent memory store. Retrieve records by relevance and recency. Periodically summarize older records and delete low-value raw observations. Keep important facts and a small working context for the current task.

Use a durable memory store with separate working context, episodic records, and versioned semantic facts. Enforce a 256 MiB total persistent-memory quota, including indexes, summaries, and metadata, plus a 16 KiB working-context cap. Admit writes transactionally only after reserving capacity; reject or evict when capacity is unavailable. Rank eviction by usefulness, recency, and retrieval frequency. Keep provenance links and confidence with each fact; summarize only when the new record costs less than its inputs. Compact periodically and measure size and retrieval usefulness.

known_weaknesses.description: Summarization does not guarantee a hard storage bound.
known_weaknesses.evidence: The initial proposal has no byte quota or admission control.

candidates.content: Use a durable memory store with working context, episodic records, and versioned semantic facts. Enforce a 256 MiB total storage quota covering records, indexes, summaries, metadata, logs, and temporary compaction files; cap working context at 16 KiB. Reserve 20% of storage for transactional compaction and recovery. Atomically reserve bytes before each write; evict low-value records or reject writes if the reservation fails. Compaction must operate within reserved headroom and recover from a committed manifest after crashes. Enforce a bounded log and bounded backup retention. Summaries retain provenance and consume the same quota. Cap pinned records at 10% of storage; when full, require explicit replacement or reject additional pins. Conflicting facts coexist with source, time, and confidence until evidence supports resolution. Under overload, return a visible admission failure rather than silently losing critical facts. Measure bytes, eviction rate, rejection rate, and retrieval utility. Verify with sustained ingestion, all-pinned saturation, concurrent write admission, and crash-during-compaction tests; assert that total storage never exceeds quota and committed records remain recoverable. These are proposed checks, not executed results. The tradeoff is explicitly bounded retention, not perfect lifetime recall.

operators.name: WHY
operators.prompt_template: Which important conclusions lack a causal justification? Identify what would establish the link.

operators.name: HOW
operators.prompt_template: Inspect how the proposed mechanism actually works. Identify missing operational steps and interfaces.

operators.name: IF
operators.prompt_template: Vary an important operating condition. Which conclusion no longer follows and under what conditions?

operators.name: WHAT
operators.prompt_template: Identify ambiguous requirements, missing definitions, or outputs the task needs but the answer omits.

operators.name: WHICH
operators.prompt_template: Which decision depends on unstated selection criteria? Compare the relevant tradeoffs.

operators.name: CAN
operators.prompt_template: Can this proposal be implemented within the stated resources and constraints? Find feasibility gaps.

operators.name: WHAT_BREAKS
operators.prompt_template: Assume the proposal has been deployed and failed badly. Identify plausible structural causes, including overload, partial failure, recovery, and adversarial inputs.

operators.name: WHY_NOT
operators.prompt_template: Challenge a rejected or ignored approach. Is its exclusion justified by evidence and constraints?

operators.name: IMPROVE
operators.prompt_template: Find the change most likely to improve task outcomes materially. Explain its expected effect and cost.

operators.name: ASSUMPTION
operators.prompt_template: Identify hidden assumptions that the current answer depends on. State how each could be checked.

operators.name: COUNTEREXAMPLE
operators.prompt_template: Construct a concrete counterexample to a central claim. Explain exactly which claim it falsifies.

operators.name: ALTERNATIVE
operators.prompt_template: Identify a materially different approach and the conditions in which it outperforms this proposal.

operators.name: EVIDENCE
operators.prompt_template: Identify unsupported factual or quantitative claims. Specify the evidence required to substantiate them.

operators.name: CONSTRAINT
operators.prompt_template: Check the answer against explicit task constraints. Identify a concrete violation or untested guarantee.

operators.name: SECOND_ORDER_EFFECT
operators.prompt_template: Identify delayed consequences, feedback loops, and incentives introduced by the proposal.

operators.name: SIMPLIFY
operators.prompt_template: Find complexity that can be removed while preserving requirements. Identify the cost it currently imposes.

operators.name: VERIFY
operators.prompt_template: Identify important claims without a falsifiable check. Specify a test and an observable pass criterion.

Enforce a 256 MiB total persistent-memory quota, including indexes, summaries, and metadata, plus a 16 KiB working-context cap. request.prompt: Produce a complete revised answer implementing the explicit revision plan. Retain requirements already satisfied and state material limitations. Do not claim unperformed verification.

content.content: Use a durable memory store with working context, episodic records, and versioned semantic facts. Enforce a 256 MiB total storage quota covering records, indexes, summaries, metadata, logs, and temporary compaction files; cap working context at 16 KiB. Reserve 20% of storage for transactional compaction and recovery. Atomically reserve bytes before each write; evict low-value records or reject writes if the reservation fails. Compaction must operate within reserved headroom and recover from a committed manifest after crashes. Enforce a bounded log and bounded backup retention. Summaries retain provenance and consume the same quota. Cap pinned records at 10% of storage; when full, require explicit replacement or reject additional pins. Conflicting facts coexist with source, time, and confidence until evidence supports resolution. Under overload, return a visible admission failure rather than silently losing critical facts. Measure bytes, eviction rate, rejection rate, and retrieval utility. Verify with sustained ingestion, all-pinned saturation, concurrent write admission, and crash-during-compaction tests; assert that total storage never exceeds quota and committed records remain recoverable. These are proposed checks, not executed results. The tradeoff is explicitly bounded retention, not perfect lifetime recall.
